title: Report to the ACCC as a designated cash distribution entity
what: An entity designated under the cash distribution framework must give the ACCC a report on its service and access agreements when its designation comes into force.

sources.title: Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026
sources.quote: 19 Requirement to give ACCC report upon becoming a designated entity (1) A designated entity must give to the ACCC a written report containing the information specified in section 21 in relation to any service agreement or access agreement for which it is a provider at the time its designation under section 14 comes into force.
